description.value: Gorge Harbour Marina Resort is a 100% Indigenous-owned (Klahoose First Nation) year-round marina and resort perched on the northwest shore of Gorge Harbour on Cortes Island, at the edge of Desolation Sound. It offers full-service RV sites, unique glamping domes, an outdoor pool and hot tub, an on-site general store, and a food truck, making it a well-appointed base for exploring the Discovery Islands. The resort has been recognised with a 2026 Canadian Business Award for Best Coastal Marina & Resort.
